sentences.text: Rear Admiral Alan Bartlett Shepard Jr. -LRB- November 18 , 1923 -- July 21 , 1998 -RRB- was an American astronaut , naval aviator , test pilot , and businessman .	test pilot	test pilot	Rear Admiral	Rear admiral (United States)	astronaut	astronaut	naval aviator	United States naval aviator	businessman	businessman

A graduate of the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis , Shepard saw action with the surface navy during World War II .	United States Naval Academy	United States Naval Academy	Annapolis	Annapolis	World War II	World War II
He became a naval aviator in 1946 , and a test pilot in 1950 .	test pilot	test pilot	naval aviator	United States naval aviator

He was selected as one of the original NASA Mercury Seven astronauts in 1959 , and in May 1961 he made the first manned Project Mercury flight , MR-3 , in a spacecraft he named Freedom 7 .	NASA	NASA	MR-3	Mercury-Redstone 3	Mercury Seven	Mercury Seven	Project Mercury	Project Mercury
His craft entered space , but did not achieve orbit .	orbit	orbit
He became the second person , and the first American , to travel into space , and the first person to manually control the orientation of his spacecraft .

In the final stages of Project Mercury , Shepard was scheduled to pilot the Mercury-Atlas 10 -LRB- MA-10 -RRB- , which was planned as a three-day mission .	Project Mercury	Project Mercury	Mercury-Atlas 10	Mercury-Atlas 10
He named Mercury Spacecraft 15B Freedom 7 II in honor of his first spacecraft , but the mission was cancelled .

Shepard was designated as the commander of the first manned Project Gemini mission , but was grounded in 1963 due to Ménière 's disease , an inner-ear ailment that caused episodes of extreme dizziness and nausea .	Project Gemini	Project Gemini

This was surgically corrected in 1969 , and in 1971 , Shepard commanded the Apollo 14 mission , piloting the Apollo Lunar Module Antares to the most accurate landing of the Apollo missions .	Apollo 14	Apollo 14	Apollo Lunar Module	Apollo Lunar Module	Apollo	Apollo program

At age 47 , he became the fifth and oldest person to walk on the Moon , and the only one of the Mercury Seven astronauts to do so .	Mercury Seven	Mercury Seven	fifth and oldest person to walk on the Moon	List of Apollo astronauts
During the mission , he hit two golf balls on the lunar surface .	lunar surface	lunar surface

He was Chief of the Astronaut Office from November 1963 to July 1969 -LRB- the approximate period of his grounding -RRB- , and from June 1971 until his retirement from the United States Navy and NASA on August 1 , 1974 .	NASA	NASA	Chief of the Astronaut Office	Chief of the Astronaut Office	United States Navy	United States Navy
He was promoted to rear admiral on August 25 , 1971 , the first astronaut to reach that rank .	astronaut	astronaut
